body:
# 漂流瓶 Mod 核心说明
## 📌 Mod 简述 | Mod Brief
本Mod新增一套趣味十足的漂流瓶异步通信系统，核心特色如下：
- 跨场景交互：单人游戏/多人服务器均可接收全球玩家投放的漂流瓶；
- 随机体验：瓶内内容或善意、或恶意，开启后触发随机游戏效果；
- 互动与留存：可回复/无视瓶中信，也可撰写内容投放；当回复数达标时，互动记录将收录至纪念册，永久留存跨服跨时空的游戏回忆。

This mod adds a fun asynchronous communication system featuring drift bottles, with core features as follows:
- Cross-scenario interaction: Receive drift bottles thrown by players worldwide in single-player mode or multiplayer servers;
- Random experience: The contents of the bottles may be kind or malicious, and opening them triggers random in-game effects;
- Interaction & retention: Reply to/ignore the messages in the bottles, or write and throw your own content; when the number of replies reaches the threshold, the interaction records will be saved in a memorial album, permanently preserving cross-server and cross-time game memories.

---

## 🔒 Communication & Privacy Notice
The bottle communication interaction function of this mod requires connection to the server address.：`cbcustom.zeabur.app`
- Optional function: When the function is not needed, it can be manually disabled in the configuration file.；
- Information collection scope (for service implementation only)：
  ✅ Time
  ✅ IP address
  ✅ Drift bottle content
  ✅ Game ID
- Privacy Guarantee: No other information is collected whatsoever.

## 🔒 通信与隐私说明
本Mod的漂流瓶通信交互功能需连接服务器地址：`cbcustom.zeabur.app`
- 功能可选：无需使用该功能时，可在配置文件中手动关闭；
- 信息收集范围（仅用于服务实现）：
  ✅ 时间
  ✅ IP地址
  ✅ 漂流瓶内容
  ✅ 游戏ID
- 隐私保障：除此以外，无任何其他信息被收集
